title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Pandian is annoyed as Kannan listens to music through earbuds at work and ignores him. Sembaruthi feels touched by Nadesan's love and care after tasting his homemade biryani.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Revathi makes Bagyaraj realise Malar's feelings and encourages him to reveal how much he misses her. Meanwhile, Mathi rejoices as she receives confirmation of her job.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Aishwarya uses Eshwari's voice to demand ₹5 lakh from Perumal, threatening to expose him and Abinav. Later, Abinav contacts Eshwari on a video call and warns her firmly.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Karikalan brings Pooja home after she refuses to return with her stepmother. He explains her plight to family and seeks their support, while Aadhavan is delighted by her arrival.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Vennila angrily confronts her office manager over his refusal to transfer money to her account. Anbu feels concerned as Kanmani yearns for her mother's support during pregnancy.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Kumaran and Sarasu enjoy their beach outing while Kandhasamy delights in his new eyeglasses. Then, the family surprises Kumaran and Sarasu with a special anniversary celebration.

title: Pandian Stores 2
episodeTitle: Gomathi's Wish to Unite the Couple
description: Gomathi urges Thangamayil and Saravanan to take their feverish child to the hospital, hoping to bring them closer. Meena and Raji plan Pandian and Gomathi's grand anniversary.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Muthu and Meena inform Chandra about Meena's pregnancy at a restaurant, leaving her upset about the delayed news. Meanwhile, Rohini asks Manoj to accompany her to invite Vijay.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri warns Gopi against forcing Divya into marriage against her wishes. Later, Abinaya's medical report brings shocking news as the doctor reveals her serious health condition.

title: Thaai Maaman
episodeTitle: Mayandi Shares His Joy With Pechi
description: Pechi questions Kaliyammal about the family's past rivals and enemies. Mayandi shares his joy with Pechi as Poongodi calls him 'Mama', and both are pleased by her transformation.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ilamathi urges Paraman to join the Panchayat election to serve the public. Kalamma tries to get Paraman to withdraw, but he refuses unless Siddharth drops out, infuriating her.
